title: Build the Zedu Alumni Network & Hiring Showcase Playbook for Bootcamp Career Teams, by Fri 11 Dec
description:
Bootcamps live and die by their graduate placement rates. By enabling academies to host post-graduation alumni networks and employer hiring showcases directly inside Zedu, bootcamps retain active communities year-round instead of losing graduates to generic LinkedIn or WhatsApp groups between cohorts. No other goal covers post-graduation retention or employer hiring workflows.

Work under this goal:
- Design the 4-channel alumni workspace taxonomy (#alumni-announcements, #job-opportunities, #career-qa, #showcase) tested against live channel controls on /[org].
- Write the graduate role transition and access management guide (moving students out of active cohort channels into alumni archives and File Management without losing past materials).
- Create the live virtual Demo Day playbook using native Zedu Buzz calls, scheduling recruiter lobby channels and live student project presentations.
- Build the graduate portfolio and resume repository structure in Zedu File Management with role-based view links for external hiring partners.

Done when: A complete, turnkey markdown operations guide is delivered with pass/fail checklists, channel message templates, and recruiter invitation workflows. Strictly grounded in live zedu.chat routes and UI controls.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Ask three bootcamp career teams how they run alumni today, then fit the playbook to their routine
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Playbooks get ignored when they don't match a team's week. Approach: short conversations with three bootcamp career leads in public communities about how alumni and hiring happen today (what they post, where graduates go after fetching results, how recruiters reach students), then map each step only to controls that exist in the app today, leaving anything the app can't do in an honest 'would need the product to...' list. Tasks: three conversations with consent notes (research), the mapped playbook (content).

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Build the alumni and recruiter playbook only on controls that exist today, mapped step by step
acceptedWorkstreams.description:
The goal asks for a guide 'strictly grounded in live zedu.chat routes and UI controls', so this approach starts by mapping each part of the plan to a real control before writing. Several controls already fit, all in the public zeduchat/zedu-fe code (staging, checked 22 Oct 2026):
- Ending a cohort: channel settings include 'Archive channel' (_components/channel-settings/channel-management.tsx lines 553 and 571), and members can 'Leave channel' (_components/menu-dropdown/index.tsx line 114).
- Recruiter access to portfolios: Files sharing offers 'Can View' or 'Can Edit', and 'Anyone with Link' or 'Only those invited' (_components/file-management/CreateShareModal.tsx), so a view-only link for an employer is possible without making them a member.
- Demo Day: Buzz starts from a channel with 'Start Buzz', and 'Copy buzz link' is in the Buzz menu (buzz-management/call-button.tsx, buzz-menu.tsx).
Tasks, each finishable:
1. Control map (research): each step in the goal (alumni channels, moving graduates, Demo Day, portfolio sharing) matched to the exact control and file, or marked 'not available, needs a workaround or the team'. It also checks whether archived channels stay readable, before the guide relies on that.
2. The playbook (content): the 4-channel alumni setup, the graduate transition steps, a Demo Day run sheet and the portfolio folder structure, using only mapped controls, with pass/fail checklists and message templates.
3. Recruiter invite workflow (content): a template message for an employer, with the view-only file link and the Buzz link, and nothing that promises features the map didn't confirm.

upvotes.reason: Building the alumni playbook only on controls that exist today prevents promising features that are not live yet — that mismatch is what erodes trust in marketing assets.

rejectedIdeas.title: Turnkey 4-Channel Alumni Directory and Recruiter File Access System with Verified UI Paths
rejectedIdeas.description:
A complete operational implementation pack for bootcamp career directors:
1. Exact 4-channel specification (#alumni-announcements, #job-opportunities, #career-qa, #showcase) with role permission rules from `/[org]/settings/organisation/roles-permissions`.
2. Step-by-step graduate role transition guide: moving students out of active cohort channels into permanent alumni discussion archives.
3. Graduate portfolio file distribution architecture in Zedu File Management (`/[org]/files`) with view-only links ('Can View' and 'Anyone with Link') for hiring partners.
4. Pass/fail educator verification checklist and copy-ready student announcement templates.

downvotes.reason: This goal already has an accepted approach that maps the same 4 channels, archive/leave steps and 'Can View' file links to real controls, so this repeats it rather than adding a different route.

It relies on 'Can View / Anyone with Link' file sharing for hiring partners, but the share dialog's Send button in CreateShareModal.tsx has no handler (open Ziki web issue #746), so that path doesn't work today.

The accepted approach already maps the same four alumni channels, graduate transition and view-only recruiter file links to existing controls. This proposal repeats those deliverables, and its Anyone-with-Link sharing path is not confirmed to work. The goal can use the accepted control map and playbook instead of running a duplicate workstream.

The accepted workstream already maps the same four alumni channels, the graduate transition and view-only recruiter links to real controls, so this repeats its scope and adds sharing claims ('Can View', link-sharing to hiring partners) that still need live verification before they can be promised. What works better: keep the accepted approach as the single workstream and add any missing copy templates as a task under it.

Restates the goal's own bullets as a pack and labels the UI paths 'verified' without evidence; the accepted approach already requires mapping each step to controls that exist today. No steps or tasks beyond the goal text.
